review_candidates.title: Administrador/a Workplace
review_candidates.description: Impulsa la evolución del puesto de trabajo digital desde la automatización, la seguridad y la eficiencia operativa Para algunas personas, la tecnología es un reto. Para otras, una oportunidad para transformar la manera en que las empresas trabajan y crecen. En Integra, no solo compartimos esa visión: la impulsamos cada día. Somos una consultora tecnológica que ofrece soluciones globales a necesidades complejas desde otro punto de vista. Escuchamos para crear progreso, integrando tecnología, experiencia y cercanía. Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a de Workplace, Automatización e Identidad para participar en proyectos de infraestructura, microinformática, automatización y gestión de identidades, asegurando la disponibilidad, seguridad y eficiencia de entornos críticos para el negocio. ¿Cuál será tu misión? Asegurar el diseño técnico, la automatización, el correcto funcionamiento y la seguridad del parque de microinformática, sistemas TPV y ecosistema de gestión de identidades y accesos. Entre tus principales responsabilidades estarán: Administrar entornos Active Directory y Azure AD / Entra ID. Diseñar y aplicar GPOs para securizar y estandarizar el puesto de trabajo. Automatizar procesos de altas, bajas y modificaciones de usuarios. Desarrollar y mantener configuraciones con Puppet, Foreman y MDT. Garantizar despliegues, actualizaciones y parches en entornos Windows y Linux. Dar soporte especialista N3 en incidencias complejas de Workplace. Participar en proyectos de mejora, documentación técnica y pruebas de concepto. Colaborar con equipos internos, ciberseguridad y áreas tecnológicas. ¿Qué perfil buscamos? Experiencia en Active Directory, Azure AD / Entra ID, GPOs y gestión de identidades. Conocimiento en automatización y despliegue de sistemas con Puppet, Foreman y MDT. Experiencia en entornos Windows y Linux. Capacidad para trabajar con infraestructuras de microinformática, puesto de trabajo digital y entornos críticos. Valorable experiencia en sistemas TPV, POS o entornos retail. ¿Qué podemos ofrecerte? Contrato indefinido desde el primer día. Creemos en las relaciones a largo plazo. Flexibilidad horaria, con entrada entre las 8:00 y las 9:00 h y salida entre las 17:00 y las 18:00 h, en modalidad híbrida con un 50% de teletrabajo. Plan de carrera individualizado, con formación continua y acompañamiento. Programa de retribución flexible: plan de pensiones, seguro de salud, plataforma de beneficios y más. ¿Por qué Integra? En Integra, creemos en las personas. Aquí se trabaja en equipo, se escucha, se propone, se mejora y se comparte. Nos mueve la innovación con sentido, y la tecnología con impacto. Porque para nosotros, integrar no es solo unir sistemas: es construir algo juntos. Porque trabajamos con propósito, y eso se nota.

review_candidates.title: Network Operations Specialist
review_candidates.description: The Network Operations Specialist provides operational and technical support for enterprise network and infrastructure services in a mission-critical environment. The position is responsible for continuously monitoring network and infrastructure performance, responding to alerts and incidents, coordinating repairs and service restoration, and maintaining accurate operational documentation. The Network Operations Specialist serves as a key point of contact for incident response and escalation, working closely with technical teams, remote support personnel, and Government representatives to maintain network availability, reliability, and operational effectiveness. The ideal candidate will have hands-on network operations experience, a strong understanding of network and infrastructure troubleshooting, and experience supporting VoIP services in an enterprise environment. Location: Iwakuni, Japan Job Type: Full-Time Work Arrangement: On-Site Security Clearance: Active Secret Clearance Required Education: High School Diploma or Equivalent Certification: Network+ or equivalent; CCNA preferred Responsibilities Essential Duties and Responsibilities Network Operations & Monitoring Monitor network infrastructure, systems, and services using enterprise monitoring and management tools. Analyze alerts, events, alarms, and performance indicators and take appropriate action to prevent or minimize service disruptions. Identify abnormal network conditions and initiate troubleshooting and escalation procedures. Monitor network availability, connectivity, performance, and capacity. Maintain awareness of the operational status of mission-critical infrastructure and services. Incident Management & Troubleshooting Respond to network and infrastructure incidents from initial triage through resolution. Troubleshoot connectivity, performance, hardware, configuration, and service-related issues. Assess incident severity and operational impact and escalate issues in accordance with established procedures. Coordinate with network engineers, systems administrators, vendors, remote technical teams, and other support personnel to resolve complex incidents. Track incidents through resolution and ensure all actions and troubleshooting steps are accurately documented. Support service restoration activities and participate in after-action reviews as required. Infrastructure Repair & Service Restoration Respond to infrastructure failures, outages, and service degradation. Coordinate and direct remote technical activities necessary to troubleshoot, repair, and restore network infrastructure. Validate system and service recovery following maintenance or repair activities. Assist with hardware replacement, configuration changes, equipment troubleshooting, and other infrastructure support activities. Support preventive maintenance and corrective actions to improve system availability and reliability. VoIP Support Monitor and troubleshoot Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) services and associated network connectivity. Assist with diagnosing voice quality, connectivity, registration, configuration, and service availability issues. Coordinate VoIP-related incidents with network, telecommunications, systems, and vendor support teams. Document troubleshooting activities and service restoration actions. Root Cause Analysis & Documentation Prepare Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation for significant incidents in accordance with Government procedures. Identify contributing factors, corrective actions, and recommendations to reduce recurrence of incidents. Maintain accurate incident records, operational logs, troubleshooting documentation, and technical reports. Ensure all required information is captured in designated Government and company systems. Data Center & Infrastructure Support Provide data center support as required, including equipment monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, and operational activities. Assist with infrastructure installations, equipment changes, and system maintenance. Follow established data center access, security, safety, and operational procedures. Maintain accurate records of equipment and infrastructure activities. Shift Operations & Reporting Document daily shift activities, incidents, maintenance activities, system status, and outstanding issues using appropriate reporting and ticketing systems. Ensure complete and accurate shift turnover and pass-down of unresolved incidents, maintenance activities, and operational concerns. Review previous shift activities and identify issues requiring immediate attention. Maintain accurate and timely ticket updates throughout the shift. Support continuous 24x7 operational coverage as required. Government & Customer Support Provide timely notification to Government representatives regarding significant incidents, outages, service degradation, and other operational events. Communicate technical information clearly and professionally to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Participate in operational briefings, incident reviews, and technical meetings as required. Maintain strict adherence to Government procedures, security requirements, and operational standards. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent. Demonstrated experience in network operations, network monitoring, infrastructure support, or a related IT environment. Hands-on experience supporting VoIP technologies. Experience troubleshooting network connectivity, infrastructure, and service availability issues. Experience working with network monitoring, ticketing, and incident-management systems. Ability to analyze alerts and incidents and determine appropriate troubleshooting and escalation actions. Strong technical documentation and communication skills. Ability to work independently and effectively in a mission-critical operational environment. Ability to support shift operations, including nights, weekends, holidays, or other non-standard hours as required. Active Secret security clearance required. Certification Requirements Candidates must possess at least one recognized network, operating system, or application support certification, such as: CompTIA Network+ Microsoft Technology Associate (MTA) Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA) Microsoft Certified Technology Specialist (MCTS) Other equivalent OEM or industry-recognized network, operating system, or application certification. Core Competencies Network Monitoring & Operations Incident Response & Troubleshooting VoIP Support Infrastructure Repair & Service Restoration Root Cause Analysis Data Center Operations Technical Documentation Government Customer Support Shift Turnover & Operational Reporting Escalation Management The anticipated salary range for this role is $60,000 to $72,000 annually. The anticipated salary range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. The final starting salary will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, including the selected candidate's qualifications, skills, relevant experience, education, certifications, and work location (where applicable), as well as internal equity and market considerations. Implement and monitor operational efficiency initiatives to enhance performance and cost-effectiveness. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented changes and make adjustments as required. Ensure effective tracking, utilization, and lifecycle management of IT assets. Ensure regular audits of IT assets are conducted to maintain accuracy and compliance with company policies. Develop and maintain comprehensive procedures and plans to ensure the timely restoration of IT services in the event of a disaster or service disruption. Managerial Responsibilities Employee Development Oversee the development of direct reports, set their objectives, identify training and development needs, and evaluate training outcomes. Professional Certifications & Licenses Intermediate or advanced IT Infrastructure Library ( ITIL ) certification. Certified Expert in Project Management. IT Help Desk / Service Desk expertise. review_candidates.title: Site Reliability Senior Staff
review_candidates.location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
review_candidates.description: Site Reliability Engineer, EDA Engineering Compute Job Description Synopsys is expanding Synopsys.ai alongside traditional EDA engineering compute for semiconductor customers in Vietnam. We are looking for an experienced Unix/Linux infrastructure professional to keep these platforms reliable, secure, and operable in Synopsys sites and at major customer environments (including customer-hosted, air-gapped, and high-security on-prem deployments). You will join the regional EDA Engineering Compute / platform operations team working with global IT, AE engineering, and product teams. Your work directly enables R&D and customer engineering teams to run EDA and GenAI workloads—from HPC batch grids through containerized AI gateways, vector data services, and agent/MCP-based tool execution on the grid. The successful candidate will support Synopsys Vietnam engineering compute and data center services, and partner on in-country deployment and sustainment of the related platform components for key semiconductor accounts. How This Role Contributes Improves availability, operability, and utilization of business-critical EDA and Synopsys.ai infrastructure in Vietnam. Reduces operational risk for customer air-gapped and customer-hosted deployments through strong runbooks, monitoring, and incident practices. Connects customer HPC schedulers, shared storage, GPU compute, and platform gateways so Synopsys tools and GenAI services run predictably at scale. Extends APAC shared-support coverage with Japan, Korea, Taiwan, and China peers. Responsibilities Engineering compute and data center Maintain Synopsys Vietnam engineering compute and data center environments per corporate IT, data center, and security standards. Support server hardware lifecycle activities: installation, provisioning, maintenance, upgrade planning, retirement, and decommissioning. perform capacity planning, performance troubleshooting, and vendor/customer coordination at customer sites. Operate and troubleshoot Linux-based EDA compute: virtualization, engineering resource management, job schedulers, license connectivity, and remote access services. Run HPC operations: cluster health, scheduler integration (LSF, Slurm, or similar), InfiniBand where deployed, and performance-related incidents. Collaborate with corporate network and information security on data center connectivity, switching, firewalls, routing, and circuits. Synopsys.ai platform operations (customer and Synopsys environments) Support deployment and day-2 operations for Synopsys EDA and AI reference patterns in Vietnam: customer-hosted and air-gapped container environments, API/AI gateways, LLM gateway integration (cloud or on-prem inference endpoints per customer policy), and customer-controlled vector database/GPU compute where applicable. Partner on install, upgrade, and configuration of platform components that connect user/agent workflows to the engineering grid—e.g., job services, unified MCP server patterns, and tool execution on LSF/Slurm-backed clusters (in coordination with products and global platform teams). Implement and maintain observability, alerting, authentication/authorization integration (e.g., customer IdP, OIDC/SSO/OAuth patterns), and operational documentation for platform services. Support agentic AI platform rollouts where components run locally, centrally, or on the grid; escalate design questions to global architecture and engineering teams. Reliability, improvement, and customer engagement Own or co-own runbooks, monitoring/alerting policies, and automation (scripts, IaC, or equivalent) to reduce toil across the APAC team. Apply AI-assisted workflows to improve troubleshooting, knowledge management, and routine operations. On-call and incident response: shared rotation (weekday nights, weekends, and holidays); lead or support incident bridges; produce post-incident reports in English. Customer air-gapped and on-site support: planned upgrades, break-fix, and customer training for isolated HPC and on-prem AI sites. Travel within Vietnam and APAC as needed (typically 10–20% of time). Cross-regional collaboration: handoffs, documentation, and mentor junior staff where applicable. Required Skills And Experience Technical 5+ years in Linux system administration, infrastructure engineering, or production network/storage support. Enterprise data center experience: servers, storage, networking, monitoring, and operational processes. HPC or EDA engineering compute: Linux clusters, workload schedulers (LSF, Slurm, or similar), and production support. Ability to support GPU-enabled compute and containerized platform services in customer-controlled environments. Familiarity with virtualization, remote access, observability stacks, and infrastructure automation. Understanding of secure multi-tier deployments: gateways, service-to-service auth, and operational telemetry (logs, metrics, tracing) for distributed platform components.

review_candidates.title: Power Platform Solution Architect
review_candidates.description: We are looking for an experienced Power Platform Solution Architect to join an international Agile delivery team. The successful candidate will act as the architecture lead for defined initiatives within the client's Microsoft Power Platform landscape, designing secure, scalable, and supportable solutions across Power Platform, Azure, and connected enterprise systems . The role combines architectural leadership with practical technical involvement, guiding delivery teams from concept and solution design through implementation, deployment, production stabilization, and continuous improvement. Tasks Act as the architecture lead for defined initiatives within the client's Power Platform landscape. Translate business capabilities, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into pragmatic end-to-end solution architectures. Design end-to-end architectures covering Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages, Azure services, and external integrations . Define solution boundaries, data models, integration patterns, security concepts, environment strategies, and deployment approaches. Evaluate and guide decisions between configuration, low-code, and custom development approaches. Assess the appropriate use of technologies such as React, PCF, Azure Functions, and other Azure components . Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, identity and access management, data protection, ALM, security, and operational support requirements. Define and maintain appropriate environment strategies across development, testing, staging, and production. Lead architecture reviews and document architecture decisions, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and exceptions. Support solution estimation, backlog refinement, technical planning, and delivery planning with product owners and engineering teams. Provide technical guidance to developers and review solution designs, technical approaches, integration patterns, and deployment concepts. Coach delivery teams and promote consistent architecture and engineering practices. Provide technical leadership during critical releases, production stabilization, incident investigation, and root-cause analysis. Identify and mitigate technical risks before they impact delivery or production. Balance governance and architectural standards with practical delivery needs, avoiding unnecessary complexity. Requirements 8+ years of solution architecture, solution design, or software engineering experience , including substantial hands-on experience designing enterprise Microsoft Power Platform solutions. Proven experience designing and delivering production solutions spanning multiple applications, environments, systems, and integration endpoints . Strong expertise in Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Power Platform architecture . Strong understanding of Dataverse data modelling, relationships, security roles, permissions, identity, and enterprise data architecture . Strong knowledge of REST APIs, integration patterns, connectors, and enterprise application integration . Practical experience with Microsoft Azure and designing solutions that integrate Power Platform with Azure services. Hands-on experience with managed solutions, environment strategies, source control, Azure DevOps, and structured ALM practices . Strong understanding of CI/CD and deployment strategies for enterprise Power Platform solutions. Ability to define and assess non-functional requirements covering security, performance, scalability, availability, reliability, supportability, maintainability, and compliance . Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID and enterprise identity and access management concepts. Experience defining security architecture and data protection approaches for enterprise applications. Experience evaluating when to use configuration, low-code, custom development, or external services to achieve the appropriate solution architecture. Practical understanding of React, PCF controls, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, and/or event-driven integration is an advantage. Experience with Copilot Studio, AI Builder, and the architecture or governance of AI-enabled business solutions is an advantage. Experience with Power Pages and external-facing Power Platform solutions is an advantage. Experience supporting distributed, remote, or nearshore development teams is an advantage. Microsoft Power Platform or Azure architecture certification, particularly PL-600 , is an advantage. Proven ability to facilitate architecture decisions with both technical and business stakeholders . Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to different audiences. Strong experience producing clear, structured, and traceable architecture documentation and technical decisions . Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, delivery-oriented approach. Ability to provide hands-on technical guidance and validate key architectural decisions without becoming disconnected from implementation realities. Professional English communication skills , including strong written and verbal communication in an international engineering environment.
